A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CGT video-compression work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–B are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original CGT compression results, timing measurements, component ablations, and generalization experiments in Sections 5.2–5.5, alongside some baseline results attributed to earlier work.

after.justification: v2 retains the original CGT experiments and outcomes in Sections 5.2–5.5 and Tables 1–6. Results retained from v1 still constitute original empirical evidence.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendices A–B retain the temporal context resampler, shared-parameter teacher/student network, dependency-weighted soft top-k selection, losses, and eight-step decoding. The revised attention illustration does not establish a procedural or architectural change.

E1.justification: Both versions train on Vimeo-90k and evaluate video compression on MCL-JCV, UVG, and HEVC-B. No training or evaluation domain, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and plots. Table 2 retains the min-entropy, checkerboard, and block-autoregressive variants; the DCVC-DC comparison in Section 5.4 was already present in v1.

E3.justification: The versions retain the same preprocessing, RGB PSNR/MS-SSIM and bpp metrics, model dimensions, eight-step decoding, and GoP of 32. The three-stage training procedure and stated training budgets in Appendix B are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Sections 5.2–5.4 retain the same resampler ablation, decoding-strategy comparison, weighting-coefficient sensitivity analysis, explicit-modeling versus proxy-task comparison, and alternative-codec generalization experiment. The new introductory diagram supplies no additional experimental analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or error bars. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 and the matched generalization and rate-distortion plots retain the same results. For example, Table 2 retains the −11.2% average for CGT-DWSCA, and Tables 5 and 6 retain CGT averages of −50.6% and −74.7%, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations (1) and (4) rename the same temporal context from y_t^C to y_t^T without changing its definition. The added diagram formulas explain existing entropy and attention operations; no new mathematical argument, assumption, theorem, or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same efficiency and spatial-dependency contributions, including the approximately 65% entropy-modeling-time reduction and 11% BD-rate reduction claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning importance versus certainty, training–inference alignment, temporal-context efficiency, and codec generalization retain their meaning. The new introductory figure visualizes limitations of prior approaches already discussed in v1; Appendix B's training-instability discussion is unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 Figure 3 adds the attention expression and Q/K/V/B matrix dimensions to the schematic shown as Figure 2 in v1. This provides limited technical clarification of the existing operation. Hyperparameters, hardware disclosure, appendix training details, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 47 references and substantive positioning relative to previous compression methods. Changed reference back-links reflect pagination, while the new introductory diagram repeats the existing motivation.

P1.justification: v2 lightly condenses the explicit-modeling discussion in Section 5.3, revises the attention-figure caption, and changes temporal-context notation. The section sequence, principal narrative, and appendix text are retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figure 1 illustrating existing entropy-modeling approaches and redraws v1 Figure 2 as Figure 3 with attention formulas and tensor shapes. Other figures are renumbered, and surrounding text and algorithm placement reflow; the empirical plots, tables, and appendix diagram are retained.

improvement.justification: The new introductory diagram makes the temporal and spatial modeling motivation easier to follow, while the redrawn attention figure documents computations and dimensions missing from v1's schematic. These provide a modest explanatory improvement. The scientific method, empirical evidence, and appendix content remain unchanged, so the revision does not substantially strengthen validation.
